text: Sorry if this is a silly one. I have my grandson tonight, he's 6. Temperature 39.3. Earlier he banged his head on the coffee table, cried straight away, and he's been absolutely his usual self since. One of his eyes has gone pink and sticky too, gunk in the corner. He's breathing fine, no trouble there, and he's been to the loo for a wee a few times so that all seems normal. His mum's away and I didn't want to just sit on it.
